4. On the Item 013 detail screen, tap the **Export** button
5. App immediately crashes with an ANR-style "BenchTarget keeps stopping" dialog and drops to the home screen

Verified deterministic: reproduced twice in a row on Item 013. Items 001–012 (the rest of the "early part of the list") were each tested with Export and did **not** crash — Item 013 is specifically the trigger.

```

```
